newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pembinaan says in talks on India project.
newsitem.headline: Pembinaan says in talks on India project.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Pembinaan YCS Bhd said in a statement on Wednesday it is currently negotiating to acquire two independent power projects in India and is selling retail space in Kuala Lumpur.
The company's shares have been suspended since May 19, when they were last traded at 13.20 ringgit.
The sale of the retail space would yield "close to 100 million ringgit," the company said.
"Further details of the aforesaid negotiations will be announced to the public once the same is finalised," the company said ina statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
